name: Thread Pattern Debug Agent
description: Reference/debug agent demonstrating how to run long blocking work off the event loop (asyncio.to_thread) while streaming progress observed from the _execute coroutine. Useful for validating heartbeats and streaming during long-running tasks.

skills.name: Run Blocking Task
skills.description: Run a long blocking compute on a worker thread and stream progress updates observed from the event loop. The client-agent waits for completion; status updates and heartbeats flow for the full duration.
skills.usage_notes: Foreground demo of the thread/observe pattern. Set duration_seconds to control how long the worker blocks (defaults to 60).
skills.output_format: JSON with status, requested_seconds, elapsed_seconds, and a summary message

duration_seconds.description: How many seconds the blocking compute should run inside the worker thread. Optional; defaults to 60.

skills.name: Run Background Task (scaffolded)
skills.description: SCAFFOLDED, NOT YET IMPLEMENTED. Intended to run the blocking task detached as an A2A background task: return immediately with a 'working' status and deliver a 'completed' status once the worker finishes. Currently returns a not-implemented response.
skills.usage_notes: Placeholder for the future background-task feature. Use run_blocking_task for the working demo.
skills.output_format: JSON with status 'not_implemented' and an explanatory message

duration_seconds.description: How many seconds the background blocking compute would run. Optional; defaults to 60.
